create_enum_factor_group: create an EnumFactorGroup with explicit valid configurations and optional log potentials for probabilistic inference
create_pairwise_factor_group: create a PairwiseFactorGroup representing factors connecting exactly two variables with log potential matrices
build_variables_to_factors: build a dictionary mapping connected variable sets to EnumFactor instances from a factor group
flatten_factor_data: flatten structured log potential or message arrays into a 1D flat array for internal optimization
unflatten_factor_data: unflatten a 1D data array back into structured log potential or message arrays for a factor group
